IssueType: P0 Critical Electrical & Reference Designator Error
Description: Active 600mA LDO regulator is mislabeled as connector 'J_PWR' instead of 'U4' or 'VR1'. Schematic symbol has only 3 pins (1:VIN, 2:GND, 3:VOUT), but physical SOT-23-5 has 5 pins (1:VIN, 2:GND, 3:EN, 4:NC, 5:VOUT). Pin 3 is wired to /3V3 in schematic, meaning Enable is wired to 3V3 rail and actual VOUT (Pin 5) is left unrouted and floating! LDO will produce 0V output.

KiCad DRC schematic parity check flags net mismatch on J_USB pads: Pad net /GND does not match schematic net /USB_VBUS, and Pad net /USB_VBUS does not match schematic net /USB_DM_PORT. Footprint pad mapping is shifted/rotated relative to symbol, creating direct VBUS-to-GND or VBUS-to-Data short on insertion.

Historical documentation claims D3 is MBR0520L forming a dynamic USB/battery power-path switch. In reality, D3 is a 1N5819HW-7-F Schottky diode wired exclusively as an inductive flyback clamp across the haptic motor (between VBAT_SW and HAPTIC_LOW). No dynamic USB/battery power-path circuit exists.

Historical Rev F engineering reports claim a P-channel MOSFET (DMG2305UX) provides automatic USB/battery power-path switching. Inspected KiCad schematic SmartPen.kicad_sch, netlist, and SmartPen_RevF_BOM.csv confirm this transistor does not exist. Power path is entirely unswitched; VBUS connects only to battery charger.

IssueType: P0 Critical Battery Safety & Charging Hazard
Description: MCP73831 PROG resistor R9 is 3.3 kOhm, programming a 303 mA charge current. If the battery is a 130-150 mAh cell (consistent with 15 mm pen barrel constraints), 303 mA represents a dangerous 2.0C - 2.33C charge rate (max safe is 0.5C-1.0C = 65-130 mA). Severe risk of cell swelling, overheating, and thermal runaway.

IssueType: P1 Battery Safety & DFM Silkscreen Omission
Description: J_BAT footprint J_BAT.kicad_mod contains no polarity indicator (+ / -) in F.SilkS silkscreen. Pin 1 is VBAT (+3.7V) and Pin 2 is GND. Assembly operator cannot visually verify harness insertion polarity, creating high risk of reversed LiPo connection during assembly.

Power switch SW3 is in series between VBAT and VBAT_SW. When SW3 is OFF, plugging in USB-C powers charger U2, but VBAT_SW remains 0V. The system cannot power up from USB when the switch is OFF. Conversely, if battery is deeply discharged, the pen cannot boot even on USB power.

U1 exposed pad (Pin 33 GND) connects to thermal ground vias. In working PCB SmartPen.kicad_pcb, clearance violations exist around U1 fine-pitch pads. In delivery PCB, U1 pads are shorted to adjacent signal tracks.
U3 QFN-20 footprint has multiple clearance and hole-clearance violations in working PCB. Address pins A0, A1, A2 are tied to GND (I2C address 0x20).

Front MPU daughterboard schematic includes 4.7k pull-up resistors on I2C SDA and SCL. Main PCB already includes R10 and R11 (4.7k). When connected, parallel resistance is 2.35 kOhm. Functional but redundant.

IssueType: P2 Schematic Parity Net Prefix Mismatch
Description: Touch_Sensor.kicad_pcb uses unqualified net names ('3V3', 'GND', 'TOUCH_IN', 'TOUCH_OUT'), whereas Touch_Sensor.kicad_sch exports hierarchical net names ('/3V3', '/GND', '/TOUCH_IN', '/TOUCH_OUT'). Generates 16 false schematic parity DRC violations in KiCad 10.

IssueType: P2 DFM FPC Cable Routing & Strain Relief
Description: 6-pin 0.5mm pitch FPC connector mates with Main PCB J_SD. Mating envelope and FPC flex radius within 15 mm barrel require mechanical retention to prevent dislodging during pen click mechanism motion.
